summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, reporting May 2026 distributions, April 2026 NAV, and the status of its continuous public offering. The fund declared regular and variable supplemental distributions per class payable to May 31, 2026 record holders around June 30, 2026. NAV per share was $24.73 for all classes as of April 30, 2026; aggregate NAV was $12.59 billion. The continuous offering sold about 553 million shares for $13.9 billion through May 1, 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions and NAV, not a special situation event.
